SELECT ts_doy, ts_hour, wtmp_c, ROUND(wtmp_c * 9/5 + 32, 1) as wtmp_f
FROM pier
WHERE ts_season = 6 AND ts_doy >= 240
ORDER BY ts_doy DESC, ts_hour DESC
LIMIT 20

SELECT fish_date_doy, cls, COUNT(*) as boats, ROUND(AVG(yt / anglers), 3) as yt_per_angler
FROM trips
WHERE fish_date_season = 6 AND fish_date_doy >= 235 AND fish_date_doy <= 244 AND yt > 0
GROUP BY fish_date_doy, cls
ORDER BY fish_date_doy DESC, yt_per_angler DESC
